[[File:Concord_Dawn_Harvester_1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Fett family harvester]]
'''Harvesters''' were used by [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Rok]] and [[Zol]] brought a harvester on their [[Factory ship]] to the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to harvest lumber, but were foiled by the [[foonar]]s and [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="Ewoks">[[Ewoks (1985) 5|''Ewoks'' (1985) 5]]</ref>

[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[Clan Fett|family]] owned a harvester for use on [[Fett homestead|their farm]] on [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]], which Jango knew how to service even as a young boy.<ref name="Jango">[[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 1|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 1]]</ref>

[[WeeGee]], the [[farmer/Legends|farmer]] [[droid/Legends|droid]] of the [[Katarn family]], was familiar to the controls of a combine.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
